title: Select a whole branch
description: Folder checkboxes include eligible descendants while partial selections and unavailable files stay explicit.
useCase: Choose a nested export scope without losing track of partially included folders.
interaction: Select a folder or file, expand Typography, and watch ancestor counts reconcile.
reducedMotion: Checkbox marks and disclosure arrows update immediately for keyboard input, reduced motion and inactive hosts. Inactive hosts disable every input.
limitations: Six local fixture files; selection does not create or download an archive. Folder-depth and unavailable-file configuration rebuild the fixture.
look: Ink-blue file panel with mint checks, narrow connector elbows, quiet branch counts and a persistent export tally.
motion: A pointer toggle settles the check mark over 140 ms; a partial mark resolves into a check while ancestor counts update immediately. Disclosure arrows rotate without delaying selection.
adapt: The `fixture` function builds a bounded tree and `leafIds` derives descendants. `Selection` changes eligible IDs only. Tune the exported `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop; changing `depth` or `disabledLeaves` remounts the fixture.
